page_title: FIO 1-1 GEN | Fiorentina v Genoa 15/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Davide Di Marco interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Koni De Winter (Genoa). Fiorentina earn a free kick.
90+6' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Mattia Bani (Genoa) gets booked.
90+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 20:7.
90+1' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
87' It's a throw-in for Genoa.
84' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) replaces Giacomo Bonaventura.

82' Nicolas Gonzalez smashes in a cross, but Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) finds it almost impossible to control and sends his header high over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Kevin Strootman (Genoa) is replacing Milan Badelj.
79' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
78' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

76' Josep Martinez doesn't have to worry about this one. Michael Kayode plays a pass into the feet of Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
75' The resulting corner from Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is cleared.

75' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
72' NO PENALTY! Referee Davide Di Marco has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Genoa players are incensed.
70' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Genoa using VAR. Let's see what happens.
70' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) is penalised for holding. Davide Di Marco signals a set piece. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Genoa.
69' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) will take a corner kick.

66' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Josep Martinez leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
63' Djed Spence (Genoa) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
61' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Caleb Ekuban will be replaced by Mateo Retegui (Genoa).
61' Here is a change. Stefano Sabelli is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Djed Spence (Genoa).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aaron Martin leaves the pitch and Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) comes on.
60' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) launches a cross from the corner, but Josep Martinez is alert to thwart the effort.
58' The referee blows his whistle as Mattia Bani (Genoa) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Fiorentina in a dangerous position.
55' Substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) has come on for Lucas Beltran.
55' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Andrea Belotti is replaced by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
55' Substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) in, Riccardo Sottil out.
54' 1 - 1 Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the right post.

54' A precise low pass is received by Arthur Melo (Fiorentina), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
51' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but Pietro Terracciano comfortably gathers the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
50' Davide Di Marco blows his whistle as Aaron Martin (Genoa) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Fiorentina have been awarded a free kick.
49' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Genoa.
48' A raking crossfield pass from Aaron Martin (Genoa) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. The ball has crossed the sideline. Genoa are taking a throw-in.
46' Half-time substitution. Vincenzo Italiano decided to make a change. Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) is replaced by Arthur Melo.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
44' Junior Messias (Genoa) is substituted due to injury. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Morten Thorsby.
42' 0 - 1 Goal! Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Pietro Terracciano to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
42' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is going to take the penalty!
40' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Genoa are awarded a penalty kick!
38' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Josep Martinez has no trouble gathering it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
37' The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a throw-in.

36' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
35' The foul by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) was seen by Davide Di Marco who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Genoa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
33' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) finds Lucas Martinez Quarta with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
32' The corner from Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) is intercepted by the defence.
31' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. Good work from Fiorentina as they win a corner.
30' Aaron Martin (Genoa) commits a foul and Davide Di Marco immediately signals a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
28' Celebrations are cut short for Fiorentina as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
27' Wait! Referee Davide Di Marco has indicated he is going to review the Fiorentina goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
25' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
23' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Genoa have a free kick.
22' A cross from a corner kick by Genoa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

22' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Pietro Terracciano makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.

18' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
16' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
15' Mattia Bani (Genoa) and Josep Martinez perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.

13' Junior Messias (Genoa) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Pietro Terracciano makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
10' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is behind the touchline and Fiorentina will take a throw-in.

7' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) with a wonderful solo effort. He blasted from long range, but the shot towards the bottom left corner was thwarted by Josep Martinez. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
5' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
5' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
4' The game has come to an end for Junior Messias. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
3' Koni De Winter (Genoa) sends a long ball in, but Pietro Terracciano comfortably gathers the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
2' The ball is out of play. Genoa will take a throw-in.
1' Davide Di Marco blows his whistle and it's Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Fiorentina will take a free kick near the side line.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Genoa will take the kick-off.
Davide Di Marco got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
